pages.title: Saddle
pages.text: A $(item)Saddle$() can be equipped on any adult $(l:agriculture/animal_husbandry#equines)Equine$() or $(l:agriculture/animal_husbandry#equines)Camilide Mammal$() when their maturity is at least above 15%. Saddles are crafted from $(l:agriculture/leather_making)Leather$() and allow you to ride suitable animals to direct their movements.

pages.title: Horse Armor
pages.text: $(item)Horse Armor$() can be equipped on any adult $(l:agriculture/animal_husbandry#equines)Horse$() when their maturity is at least above 15%. Horse armor can be made from $(l:agriculture/leather_making)Leather$() and $(l:craftsmanship/metallurgy)Metal$() and provide extra protection to your mount. Leather armor may also be dyed.

pages.title: Horseshoes
pages.text: $(item)Horseshoes$() are smithed individually from types of steel and then combined into sets. When equiped on any $(l:agriculture/animal_husbandry#equines)Equine$() or $(l:agriculture/animal_husbandry#equines)Camilide Mammal$() they provide great benefits to their stats which can be viewed in the item description.$(br)$(bold)TIP:$() It's a good idea to tie up your mount properly when using a higher tier horseshoes.

pages.title: Supply Cart
pages.text: $(item)Supply Carts$() can be attached to ridden animals with $(item)$(k:key.astikorcarts.desc)$() or pulled manually. Supply carts can hold a large amount of items in their storage, accessed with $(item)$(k:key.sneak)-$(k:key.use)$(). However, too many items, or a few very heavy items will cause your mount to slow down considerably.
The supply cart will physically display the first few items in its inventory.

pages.title: Plow
pages.text: A $(item)Plow$() can be attached to ridden animals with $(item)$(k:key.astikorcarts.desc)$() or pulled manually. Plows can hold 3 tools, accessed with $(item)$(k:key.sneak)-$(k:key.use)$(). The plow will attempt to use these tools on blocks below them when engaged with $(item)$(k:key.use)$(). Meaning that they can use $(thing)Hoes and Scythes$() to till soil, use $(thing)Shovels and Spades$() to pave paths, and even use $(thing)Axes$() to strip logs.
The plow will display its tools. It will be engaged when its arms are lowered.

pages.title: Animal Cart
pages.text: An $(item)Animal Cart$() can be attached to ridden animals with $(item)$(k:key.astikorcarts.desc)$() or pulled manually. Animal carts can hold up to $(thing)2 animals$(), which automatically enter the cart when run over with it.
The animal cart can even hold other players.

pages.title: Paving Cart
pages.text: The $(thing)Paving Cart$() is a specialized cart used for laying down road surfaces quickly and efficiently. Read more about them in the entry for $(l:logistics/roads#paving_cart)Roads$().

pages.name: Paving Cart
pages.text: The paving cart will be engaged when its blades are lowered.
